newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa says Kabila to announce government Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa says Kabila to announce government Tuesday.

text.p: Zaire's self-proclaimed President Laurent Kabila will announce his new government on Tuesday night, South African Deputy President Thabo Mbeki said on Monday.

"President Kabila will address tomorrow night the question of free political activity for everyone. It will be a broad- based government, as inclusive as possible of the various political forces," Mbeki told reporters in Johannesburg.

"A new government will be announced tomorrow night," said Mbeki, who held two hours of talks with Kabila on Sunday after the rebel alliance's ousting of former president Mobutu Sese Seko after three decades in power.
Mbeki said Mobutu's party had indicated to Kabila that it would work with the new government.
"The alliance has been greatly encouraged by communications it has received from the leadership of Mobutu's party which has said it will be willing to cooperate with the alliance."

He said he was confident that Kabila would keep his word on the formation of a widely representative government, which South Africa has been actively promoting, telling reporters: "It will be a broad-based government."
